mapper.sql: a.id, a.schedule_date, a.cx_batch_no, a.batch_no, a.order_no, a.spec_desc, a.work_code, a.tread_code, a.glue_code, a.glue_seq, a.mouth_plate_code, a.unit_consume, a.machine_id, a.stock_qty, a.supply_time, a.day_plan_qty, a.day_produce_order, a.day_sys_analysis, a.day_hand_analysis, a.night_plan_qty, a.night_produce_order, a.night_sys_analysis, a.night_hand_analysis, a.pre_plan_qty, a.cx_class1_plan, a.cx_class2_plan, a.cx_class3_plan, a.cx_class4_plan, a.cx_class5_plan, a.IS_RELEASE,a.remark,a.del_flag,a.PRODUCTION_STATUS,a.mark_close_out_tip,a.data_source,a.REINFORCE_SEAL_GLUE,
mapper.select:
select * from ( select
(IFNULL(day_plan_qty, 0) + IFNULL(night_plan_qty, 0)) as daily_total_qty, b.MONTH_PLAN_QTY as month_plan,CEILING(b.MONTH_REMAIN_QTY) as month_plan_os from t_tm_assist_schedule a LEFT JOIN ( select MATERIAL_CODE,MONTH_PLAN_QTY,MONTH_REMAIN_QTY from T_TM_MONTH_PLAN_SURPLUS where del_flag='0' and YEAR=#{year,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and MONTH=#{month,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) b on a.TREAD_CODE=b.MATERIAL_CODE where a.del_flag='0' and a.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate,jdbcType=DATE} and instr(a.spec_desc,#{specDesc ,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0 and instr(a.work_code,#{workCode ,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0 and instr(a.tread_code,#{treadCode ,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and instr(a.glue_code,#{glueCode ,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0 and a.IS_RELEASE = #{isRelease ,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and instr(a.mouth_plate_code, #{mouthPlateCode}) > 0
and instr(concat(',',a.machine_id,','), concat(',',#{machineId},','))>0
order by (case when instr(machine_id,',') > 0 then machine_id when machine_id is null or machine_id = '' then '0' else '-1' end) desc/*多个机台 和 没有机台的排在前面*/, CAST(substr(a.glue_seq,0,instr(a.glue_seq,'.')-1) AS SIGNED), CAST(substr(a.glue_seq,instr(a.glue_seq,'.')+1) AS SIGNED) asc ) t
order by ${orderStr}
